policy: These original handwriting, creative arts, rhyme/song, cooperation, self-regulation and discovery experiences are integrated as non-scored guided tasks. They require adult observation; do not convert them into multiple-choice questions or scored tests. Each child's completion and optional adult note are stored separately.

records.title: Make careful lines and shapes
instructions: Sit comfortably and hold the pencil gently with an adult's help.
Trace a short straight line, a curved line and a circle.
Draw one shape of your choice.
observableCriteria: Uses a comfortable grip with support as needed
Makes controlled marks
Attempts a recognisable line or shape
records.assessment: Adult observation; no fixed right/wrong answer.

records.title: Create a picture of a place you know
instructions: Choose a familiar place such as a garden or home.
Draw at least two things you can see there.
Tell an adult one thing about your picture.
observableCriteria: Chooses materials safely
Represents an idea using marks or shapes
Communicates one idea about the work
records.assessment: Adult observation; accept varied creative responses.

records.title: Build together and take turns
instructions: Choose blocks or safe building pieces with an adult.
Take turns adding one piece at a time.
Describe how you worked together.
observableCriteria: Waits for a turn with support
Shares materials safely
Responds to a partner's contribution
records.assessment: Adult observation; do not compare siblings or score speed.

records.title: Pause, breathe and try again
instructions: When a task feels difficult, pause your hands.
Take one slow breath with an adult.
Listen to the next small step and try again.
observableCriteria: Pauses when prompted
Attempts a calming breath
Returns to the task with support
records.assessment: Adult observation; supportive practice, never a penalty.

records.title: Observe a plant safely
instructions: With an adult, choose a plant you can see from a safe place. Do not pick, taste or touch unknown plants.
Look at a leaf, stem or flower and notice its colour or shape.
Draw what you see or tell the adult one thing you noticed.
observableCriteria: Observes the plant safely without damaging it
Describes one visible feature such as colour or shape
Records the observation through a drawing or spoken description
records.assessment: Adult observation; no fixed right/wrong answer. Never taste or handle an unknown plant.

records.title: Put plant growth pictures in order
instructions: Ask an adult to show three picture cards: a seed, a sprout and a young plant.
Arrange the cards in the order they happen: first, next and last.
Tell the adult one thing that changes as the plant grows.
observableCriteria: Places the three growth stages in a sensible order
Uses first, next and last to describe the sequence
Describes one simple change as the plant grows
records.assessment: Adult observation; accept spoken, drawn or arranged-card responses without scoring.

records.title: Make a rhyme and clap the beat
instructions: Ask an adult to say the words cat and mat, then bee and tree.
Say each pair aloud and listen for the same ending sound.
Clap the beat for each word and think of one more rhyming pair with the adult.
observableCriteria: Recognises that each pair shares an ending sound
Joins in saying or clapping the words
Attempts an original rhyming pair with support
records.assessment: Adult observation; accept spoken, repeated or gestured participation. Do not score pronunciation.

records.title: Create a picture with shapes
instructions: With an adult, choose paper, crayons and safe pre-cut shapes.
Make a picture using at least two shapes or colours. Ask an adult for help with any cutting or glue.
Tell the adult what your picture shows and why you chose the shapes.
observableCriteria: Uses materials safely with age-appropriate support
Combines shapes or colours to represent an idea
Describes one part of the picture in their own words
records.assessment: Adult observation; no fixed right/wrong answer. An adult handles cutting tools.
